versions.content: Basic Features of Mixed Content The following list indicates the features of mixed content from a modeling point of view. Within a mixed content instance • a set of formally defined model elements may appear an arbitrary number of times in arbitrary order • but the actually present order is relevant in terms of semantics of the whole object, and • In case of atpMixedString unqualified text may be mixed in between any of formally defined elements.
